title: What Does 'BP AI' Really Mean for Your Blood Pressure?
description: BP AI isn’t a medical diagnosis—it’s shorthand for AI-powered blood pressure tools. 72% of adults 35+ now use home monitors with AI features. Learn how to interpret your readings correctly—and when to act.
reasoning: Users are searching 'bp ai' because they’ve seen the term on smart cuffs, health apps, or telehealth reports—but don’t know if it’s reliable, regulated, or relevant to their real-world readings. They’re anxious about misinterpreting numbers (e.g., 145/95 at home) and need plain-language clarity on what AI adds—and what it *doesn’t* replace—especially amid rising self-monitoring and white-coat vs. masked hypertension confusion.
perplexityQuestions: Is 130/80 considered hypertension for adults over 35?
